enabled.description: Add the Traefik annotations and middlewares to the Ingress.

entrypoints.description: Traefik entrypoints the Ingress is exposed on, set in the `traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints` annotation.

forceTLS.description: Only accept TLS connections on the router. Adds the `traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.tls` annotation.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix `name` with the release fullname. Set to `false` for a middleware that is not created by this chart. Supports Helm `tpl`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the middleware. Defaults to the namespace of the Ingress.

items.description: A middleware applied to the Ingress.

middlewares.description: Traefik middlewares applied to the Ingress, in order. They can be created with `ingressMiddlewares.traefik`.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix `name` with the release fullname. Set to `false` for a middleware that is not created by this chart. Supports Helm `tpl`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the middleware. Defaults to the namespace of the Ingress.

items.description: A middleware applied to the Ingress.

chartMiddlewares.description: Same as `middlewares`, but meant for the chart developer to add middlewares specific to this Ingress. See [Traefik](/truecharts-common/ingress/integrations/traefik).

description: Traefik integration. Adds annotations and middlewares to the Ingress, see [Traefik](/truecharts-common/ingress/integrations/traefik).
